name: אדל
notes: ambiguous: אַדֶּל / אָדֶל / אֵידֶל (Yiddish Eydl); Hebrew documents most often אַדֶּל

name: ליאן
notes: ambiguous: לִיאָן / לִיאַן; also read as Lian vs Leeann

name: מאי
notes: ambiguous: מַאי (May) / מָאִי; commonly the month-name May

name: נטלי
notes: ambiguous: נָטָלִי / נַטָּלִי; foreign name (Natalie), no fixed norm

name: רויטל
notes: uncertain: usually parsed רְוִי+טַל; some write רוֹיטַל

name: יהלי
notes: uncertain: from יַהֲלוֹם; also vocalized יְהָלִי by some

name: אמילי
notes: uncertain: foreign name (Emily), no fixed nikud norm

name: ניצן
notes: uncertain: plene spelling; the Hebrew word is נִצָּן, so some point נִיצָּן

name: רינת
notes: ambiguous: רִינַת per this plene spelling; the underlying construct is רִנַּת

name: אלינור
notes: ambiguous: Hebrew אֱלִינוֹר vs foreign Eleanor אֵלִינוֹר

name: פיגא
notes: ambiguous: Yiddish Feyge — written פֵיגֶא / פֵיגָא / פֵּיגֶא in Hebrew documents

name: קארין
notes: uncertain: foreign (Karin); nikud on א is conventional only

name: הילי
notes: uncertain: modern coinage; also הִלִּי under defective spelling

name: ליהיא
notes: uncertain: modern coinage, unusual final א

name: ניקול
notes: uncertain: foreign (Nicole), no fixed nikud norm

name: אלמה
notes: ambiguous: Hebrew variant of עַלְמָה pointed אַלְמָה, or Latin Alma אָלְמָה

name: אושרת
notes: uncertain: also pointed אוֹשְׁרַת; underlying noun is אֹשֶׁר

name: סגלית
notes: uncertain: defective spelling; plene form is סִיגָלִית

name: אלכסנדר
notes: uncertain: conventional pointing only; also אַלֶכְּסַנְדֶּר

name: הינדא
notes: uncertain: Yiddish Hinde; Hebrew documents also write הִינְדֶא

name: ענהאל
notes: uncertain: recent coinage, no settled vocalization

name: שיינא
notes: ambiguous: Yiddish Sheyne — שֵׁיינָא / שֵׁינָא / שֵׁיינֶא

name: מתנאל
notes: uncertain: variant spelling of נְתַנְאֵל; also מַתְנְאֵל

name: עירן
notes: uncertain: variant spelling of ערן; also עֵירָן

name: פערל
notes: ambiguous: Yiddish Perl — Hebrew documents write פֶּערְל / פֶּרְל

name: לייה
notes: uncertain: variant spelling of לֵאָה; vocalization of the doubled י is unsettled

name: פסיה
notes: ambiguous: Yiddish Pesye — פֶּסְיָה / פֶּסְיָא / פֵּיסִיָּה

name: נאיה
notes: uncertain: modern coinage; also נַאיָה / נָאיָּה
